name: Vantablack Documentary Division
description: The nonfiction arm of Vantablack Media, VDD produces licensed documentary neural-feed content that covers history, culture, and current events within parameters approved by the Sable Charter's content governance framework. Their productions are technically excellent, immersively realized, and — critics note — consistently absent any documentation that reflects poorly on corponation governance. VDD is the primary producer of officially sanctioned historical content in GLMZ.
cultural_impact: Effectively controls the neural-feed historical record for most of GLMZ's population, making the existence of competing archives — underground or otherwise — a matter of profound political consequence.
story_hooks: A VDD senior producer has been quietly compiling a shadow archive of footage cut from official productions and needs help getting it out
VDD is producing a documentary on an event that players were directly involved in, and the production team has reached out for 'firsthand accounts' — the intent behind the request is unclear
Someone has obtained an unedited VDD production master and the difference between it and the released version is extraordinary
